system.longDesc: You can mentally speed up molecular motion to create heat and cause things to catch fire.
system.requirement: Power talent: Willpower (Pyrokinesis) power focus at Expert

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Pyrokinesis effect. You also gain the power focus Willpower (Pyrokinesis).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Pyrokinesis effect. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Pyrokinesis effects for –1 SP.
